StoryWhisperer.title: Story Whisperer
StoryWhisperer.subtitle: Every great story begins with a conversation.
StoryWhisperer.welcome: Tell me what you have in mind. We’ll find the characters, the world they live in, and what happens next.
StoryWhisperer.consent: I agree to save this conversation’s transcript and the photos I add. Voice audio may be kept for up to 7 days so I can recover an unfinished reply.
StoryWhisperer.opening: Who would you like your story to be about?
StoryWhisperer.caption: Photo caption
StoryWhisperer.error: Something went wrong. You can try again.
StoryWhisperer.resetConfirm: Start over? This will remove this conversation and its attachments from your draft.
StoryWhisperer.reviewInputs: Review your other inputs or remove a photo before continuing.
StoryWhisperer.useExisting: Use the details already in my draft
StoryWhisperer.unfinished: This voice reply is unfinished. Recover the recording, write the reply, or discard it.
StoryWhisperer.discardVoiceConfirm: Discard the voice audio that’s waiting to sync?
StoryWhisperer.resumePrompt: You have a saved conversation for this story. Would you like to continue or start over?
StoryWhisperer.draftSaveFailed: This reply could not be saved on this device.
